Expense Splitter

Log group expenses and get the minimal set of settle-up payments.

Expenses

📖 How to use

  1. Enter who paid, the amount, and who shared the expense.
  2. Click Add Expense — repeat for every expense.
  3. Click Calculate Settle-Up to see who pays whom.
  4. The result is the minimal set of transfers to even out.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does it work?

For each expense enter who paid, how much, and who shared it (comma-separated names). The tool computes balances and the fewest transfers to settle.

How are settle-up payments minimized?

The balances are netted: each person ends with a single owed amount, then a greedy algorithm pairs debtors with creditors so nobody makes more payments than needed.

Is it only for roommates?

No — it supports a free-form group; just use consistent names for each person.

Is the expense log saved?

Yes, the expense log is stored in this browser's localStorage.
